strategy.objective: Retained contribution from incremental new-customer purchases; CPC, CTR and traffic quality are diagnostics.
strategy.first_candidate: Existing US/English exact-intent dress Search campaign; Germany has its own readiness and economics gate. Prepare all actual supported market-language cohorts without funding all at once.
strategy.market_comparison: Rank by actual delivered-product contribution, truthful localized route, payment/consent readiness, then native demand evidence. Low estimated CPC alone is not a market selection rule.
strategy.alternative: Selected-product Standard Shopping only after Microsoft-specific offer, shipping, price/currency, conversion and contribution evidence. PMax and Audience prospecting remain later experiments.
strategy.asset_policy: Use existing ads and queries first. Fifteen headlines do not guarantee better conversion or lower CPC. Keep optional additions as one reviewable candidate; do not create multiple redundant RSAs by default.
strategy.test_policy: After launch acceptance and an exact loss envelope, alter one meaningful variable at a time; compare matured, country-specific new-customer contribution rather than branded/blended ROAS. No statistical confidence or results exist yet.

inventory_dependency.required_status: Finalized dated read-only inventory with country-language-route applicability, not BUILDING_READ_ONLY_INVENTORY.
inventory_dependency.rule: Do not generate a Cartesian product of every country and every published language. Bind only actual eligible country-language combinations and verify offer/checkout separately. No market list is certified by this controls file.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Account477439/customer770182; exact parent campaign/group/RSA IDs; every new row and existing affected entity stays Paused before and after.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: Do not save to a different account or duplicate an existing cohort.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Strategy, checked Max CPC field, numeric0.15 and actual USD account currency; all bid adjustments/strategy associations and inheritance.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: No substitute eCPC, uncapped bidding or silent cap increase.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Recheck new nonportfolio cap availability after2026-10-01. The earlier August31 announcement retains existing caps and portfolio caps, but arbitrary migrations are not certified.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: Hold incompatible creation; parent reviews a compatible portfolio or explicit cap decision, with no launch rush.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Country presence setting, language, ad-group distribution and permitted publisher exclusions. Both documented distribution options include Search and Audience; some select partners aggregate.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: Do not describe this as Bing-only or guaranteed Search-only.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Account auto-apply types, campaign AI Max/search matching/text customization/final URL expansion, RSA text generation, DSA and active import schedules/options. New Search defaults AI Max on per August27 announcement.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Account list, shared lists, campaign and ad-group negatives against master, every in-scope existing positive, mixed-query holdouts and native conflict report.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: Keep held garment exclusions and tee-only negatives out of dress campaigns; review each conflicting negative at its exact scope.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Ad/asset IDs, complete existing headline/description lists, pins, URL suffix and editorial states. Bulk/API updates replace supplied asset lists.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: No append-only assumption, duplicate-RSA shortcut or loss of baseline assets; validate entire merged object and read back.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Keyword/ad/template hierarchy, localized final URL, redirects, country/currency persistence, product selection, mobile route and click-ID/query-parameter continuity.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: Hold cohort when traffic lands in a wrong language, unavailable offer or broken purchase flow.

native_controls_to_read_back.required: Actual native required budget, exact approved cash/loss envelope, test timing, reconciled purchase/value/currency/deduplication and consent acceptance.
native_controls_to_read_back.failure_action: Paid launch stays blocked. Saved5/3USD figures are historical settings, not new authority or a hard cumulative stop.

negative_strategy.new_campaign_scope: Only reviewed English retail dress cohorts; translate intent and variants for other languages.
negative_strategy.existing_seed_policy: Three existing narrow phrases reused; four single-word seeds flagged for narrower alternatives. No automatic removal of current native negatives.
negative_strategy.qualified_seed_warning: The48 qualified local seeds include zero US dress-scope rows. Ad-group routing exclusions must retain scope and must not be copied campaign-wide.

brand_cannibalization.rule: Report own-brand terms and existing-customer orders separately. Do not claim incremental acquisition from blended branded ROAS.
brand_cannibalization.negative_policy: Consider reviewed own-brand exclusion only after native query and brand-control inspection; no competitor or own-brand exclusion is invented in the English waste list.

bulk_or_editor_policy.current_artifacts: Local review JSON/Markdown and legacy review CSVs; not a Microsoft Bulk import file.
bulk_or_editor_policy.future_conversion: Use a current native export/schema, explicit correct IDs and Paused states, complete merged asset arrays and reviewed JSON escaping.
bulk_or_editor_policy.default_status_hazard: Never accept an Active default from a sample, import or creation wizard.
bulk_or_editor_policy.governance: Disable or scope scheduled import updates to prevent budget/status/bid/AI changes; verify import preview and per-row outcome.
bulk_or_editor_policy.readback: Capture every created/updated ID, asset text/pins, status, destination, keyword match type, negative scope, cap and editorial status after save.
